derived_from.note: prices, fundamentals, splits, vendor event lists copied from the base and share counts (v2) from the review overlay, each verified against its frozen manifest; events rebuilt with event rules v2 from filings/ (new: SEC EDGAR submissions)

sources.filings: SEC EDGAR submissions: 8-K acceptance + items, 10-Q/10-K reportDate + acceptance
sources.fundamentals: SEC EDGAR companyfacts (XBRL); PIT key = submissions acceptanceDateTime; incl. same-filing prior-year comparatives
sources.prices: yfinance Ticker.history(auto_adjust=False): OHLC scaled to Adj Close; CloseSplitAdj = split-adjusted only
sources.shares: SEC EDGAR dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding / us-gaap weighted shares; PIT key = acceptanceDateTime
sources.universe: candidate pool: fja05680/sp500 historical S&P 500 components since 2014 + SEC listed sweep, screened (rank <= 150)

universe: point-in-time: top 100 by EDGAR shares x split-adjusted close at D-1 among the candidate pool
